A_user_bandwidth_stalls.B_justification: Fixed from the layer arithmetic-intensity distribution alone (min 2.0, median ~250, max ~597 FLOP/B) before any run: peak = 2*128*128 = 32768 FLOP/cycle, ridge = peak/B = 2048 (low: every layer below the ridge), 512 (mid: nearly all below), 128 (high: roughly half above). AMENDED: the registered 'low' level (B=16, ridge 2048) is dropped on cost alone; mid and high keep their registered ridge positions (512, 128 FLOP/B).
A_user_bandwidth_stalls.keys: InterfaceBandwidth=USER; Bandwidth = IfmapSRAMBankBandwidth = FilterSRAMBankBandwidth = B; IfmapSRAMBankNum = FilterSRAMBankNum = 1 (single_layer_sim.py takes the ifmap/filter DRAM-side bandwidth from the *SRAMBankBandwidth keys and the ofmap bandwidth from Bandwidth; read_buffer.py asserts bank_bandwidth*num_bank == total)
A_user_bandwidth_stalls.knob_sanity: per dataflow, total stall cycles over the 21 layers are non-increasing from mid (B=64) to high (B=256)
A_user_bandwidth_stalls.per_dataflow_pass: Spearman rho(AI, stall_frac) <= -0.6 at BOTH levels (mid and high) AND rho < +0.3 at both. A (dataflow, B) cell with fewer than 5 layers having stall_frac > 0 is uninformative and counts as NOT satisfying rho <= -0.6. (Stricter than the registered '>= 2 of 3 levels'.)
A_user_bandwidth_stalls.signal: stall_frac = Stall Cycles / Total Cycles per layer (COMPUTE_REPORT.csv)

B_calc_bandwidth_mode.signal: required_bw = Avg IFMAP DRAM BW + Avg FILTER DRAM BW + Avg OFMAP DRAM BW (BANDWIDTH_REPORT.csv, words/cycle)

roofline.summary: Pre-registered (model/t3_roofline2_criteria.json) re-specification: ResNet-18 real layers, USER-bandwidth stalls and CALC-mode required bandwidth vs arithmetic intensity.

roofline_part1.reason: Measured the wrong thing: (1) the TASK 3 bundled run had Stall Cycles = 0 (results/evidence/31_original_stalls.txt), so there was nothing to correlate against; (2) the substitute study used 16 hand-picked synthetic GEMMs on a 16x16 array and a binary agreement gate on a 5 % stall threshold, a metric that depends on the arbitrary threshold and class balance, and was not a real layer set. Replaced by rank correlations (threshold-free) on the real ResNet-18 layers.

summary.rule:
Roofline study: arithmetic intensity vs SCALE-Sim's memory-added cycles.

RULES (fixed here, before any result was looked at; the experiment came after the design):
  workload  : 16 synthetic GEMMs (M,N,K) spanning ~2..170 FLOP/byte (square, skinny, GEMV, K-heavy).
  machine   : R x C = 16 x 16 array, 1 byte/word (SCALE-Sim word_size=1), 64 kB SRAM per buffer,
              DRAM interface B = 4 words/cycle. Set through the bundled scale.cfg: InterfaceBandwidth=USER,
              Bandwidth = IfmapSRAMBankBandwidth = FilterSRAMBankBandwidth = B, SRAM banks = 1.
              (In the bundled google.cfg SCALE-Sim reports 0 stall cycles for every layer of every
              dataflow: interface 10 words/cycle with 6 MiB buffers hides everything, so B is lowered.)
  Two roofline variants are reported:
   (a) compulsory:  AI = FLOPs / (M*K + K*N + M*N bytes);  peak = 2*R*C FLOP/cycle; ridge = peak / B;
       predicted bandwidth-bound  <=>  AI < ridge.
   (b) effective:   traffic = DRAM words actually moved in the SCALE-Sim run (DETAILED_ACCESS_REPORT
       ifmap+filter reads + ofmap writes, i.e. including re-fetch when 64 kB cannot hold the working set);
       AI_eff = FLOPs / traffic;  predicted bandwidth-bound  <=>  traffic / B > compute_only cycles
       (memory time exceeds compute time = AI_eff below the layer's attainable-compute ridge).
  compute_only = stall-free cycles of the layer from model/analytic.py (validated exact by the fit).
  SCALE-Sim signal (observed): stall_frac = Stall Cycles / Total Cycles; bandwidth-bound <=> stall_frac > 5 %.
  Also reported: memory_added = (Total Cycles incl. prefetch - compute_only) / Total Cycles incl. prefetch.
  CHRONOLOGY (disclosed): the first rule written down used memory_added > 10 % as the observed signal; the
  first run flagged all 16 layers (the exposed initial prefetch alone exceeds 10 % everywhere), so it could
  not discriminate, and variant (a) turned out to ignore re-fetch traffic. The stall-based observed signal
  and variant (b) were therefore adopted afterwards (post-hoc); all variants are kept in roofline.json.
  Gating checks (variant b): agreement >= 80 % of layers, both classes >= 3 layers,
  Spearman(AI_eff, stall_frac) <= -0.5, for each dataflow.
